info.description: Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token is either an access token from `/api/auth/login` or an API key (`tf_...`, created with `POST /api/api-keys`). API keys only reach `/api/projects/**`, are limited per minute (429 when exceeded) and never manage projects. A person chooses the tenant with `X-Tenant`; a key's tenant is fixed.
